traceability.notes: Story 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS is clearly and comprehensively implemented. The codebase contains dedicated maintenance utilities (detection, update, batch update, verification, reporting), a fully functional CLI (`traceability-maint`), and plugin-level exports for programmatic use. Each requirement (REQ-MAINT-DETECT/UPDATE/BATCH/VERIFY/REPORT/SAFE) is both implemented in code and exercised by focused unit, integration, and performance tests that explicitly reference this story. The CLI provides clear, user-friendly feedback and distinct exit codes, supports JSON and text output, and includes safe behaviors such as dry-run mode, argument validation, and robust error handling for missing roots and permission errors. Documentation in README and API reference describes the Maintenance CLI usage and integration. All tests for this functionality pass, satisfying the acceptance criteria and definition of done for this story.
